settings.heading: Do I need an analyser to use Andatech drug test kits?
settings.text: No. Cassette-based test kits can be read visually. However, an analyser removes subjective line-reading, creates a digital record and supports audit-ready reporting — making it strongly recommended for workplace testing programs.

settings.heading: What is the difference between the OraScan Analyser and the OraScan 3000?
settings.text: The original OraScan Drug Analyser reads saliva and surface cassettes. The OraScan 3000 also reads urine cassettes — choose the model that covers all the specimen types your program uses.

settings.heading: How does the analyser store and export results?
settings.text: Test results are stored on the device and can be exported via the OraScan Dock to the Andalink platform for centralised reporting, multi-site visibility and audit records.

settings.heading: Which cassettes are compatible with the OraScan analysers?
settings.text: The analysers read OraScan Cassette V5 test kits. Check the individual product page to confirm cassette compatibility for saliva, urine and surface testing.

settings.heading: Can the analyser connect to our existing reporting system?
settings.text: The OraScan analysers integrate with the Andalink platform. If you need reporting that connects with a third-party system, discuss the requirements with an Andatech solutions specialist.
